commands.review_summary:
The branch updates the review prompt, decision schema, Mantis recommendation rendering, bot-proof dispatch gating, and focused tests to limit copyable Mantis proof suggestions to Telegram and Discord lanes while preserving unsupported legacy report fallback rendering.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a bug reproduction. The relevant check is PR behavior review: the diff, current-head rendered output in the PR body, and focused tests cover supported Discord rendering, unsupported visual fallback, and invalid mention fallback.

target.title: Clarify Mantis proof suggestion scope
target.body:
## Summary

- Narrows ClawSweeper's copyable Mantis proof recommendations to currently dispatchable Telegram and Discord lanes.
- Keeps unsupported legacy recommendations such as `visual_task` parseable, but renders them as non-Mantis proof path guidance instead of copyable `@openclaw-mantis` commands.
- Removes web UI chat from the supported ClawSweeper Mantis scope until an OpenClaw Mantis lane exists for it.

## Problem

ClawSweeper could suggest Mantis proof for surfaces Mantis cannot currently prove through a stable PR comment workflow. The reported example was a WinUI Sessions page proof suggestion that rendered an `@openclaw-mantis visual task` command, implying Mantis was an appropriate path.

## Implementation

- Updated the review prompt and structured-output schema to recommend Mantis only for Telegram and Discord proof.
- Removed `web_ui_chat_proof` from the new schema/runtime supported scenario set.
- Preserved parser compatibility for older `slack_desktop_smoke` and `visual_task` reports, but those now fall back to a `Proof path suggestion` instead of `Mantis proof suggestion`.
- Tightened bot-proof dispatch eligibility so Mantis requires both a supported scenario and a valid single-line `@openclaw-mantis` comment.
- Added focused tests for supported Telegram/Discord recommendations, unsupported WinUI/non-chat visual proof, and invalid Mantis mention fallback.

## Validation

- `pnpm run build:all` passed.
- `node --test test\review-prompt-policy.test.ts test\proof-nudge-policy.test.ts` passed, 44/44.
- `pnpm run lint:src` passed.
- `pnpm run lint:scripts` passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src\clawsweeper.ts test\proof-nudge-policy.test.ts test\review-prompt-policy.test.ts schema\clawsweeper-decision.schema.json` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed with only Windows CRLF conversion warnings.

Broader local `pnpm run test:unit` was run before this narrowing and still showed unrelated Windows baseline failures around `/bin/bash`, fake-codex sentinel setup, and CRLF-sensitive workflow fixture matching. The touched Mantis/prompt tests passed in that broader run and in the focused reruns above.

## Proof

Rendered ClawSweeper comment output from built `dist` after this patch:

- Unsupported WinUI `visual_task` recommendation:
  - `has Mantis proof suggestion: false`
  - `has @openclaw-mantis visual task: false`
  - `has Proof path suggestion: true`
  - `has narrowed scope text: true`

Rendered unsupported proof-path copy:

```text
**Proof path suggestion**
A short visible WinUI proof would materially help because this changes a Sessions page filter toggle. Mantis is currently scoped to Telegram and Discord proof, so it is not the right proof path for this surface.
Use maintainer screenshot/manual proof, browser or Playwright proof, Crabbox where appropriate, or normal local artifact proof instead.
```

- Supported Discord status reactions recommendation:
  - `has Mantis proof suggestion: true`
  - `has Discord command: true`

Rendered supported Discord command:

```text
@openclaw-mantis discord status reactions proof: verify queued and done reactions update around the worker run.
```

## Codex Review Closeout

Command: `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --base origin/main`

Result: no accepted/actionable findings. Final review summary: the changes consistently narrow public Mantis recommendations to supported Telegram/Discord lanes, suppress unsupported command text, and keep historical unsupported report rendering safe.

Earlier accepted finding handled: Codex flagged that invalid Mantis commands still needed to fall back instead of dispatching; this branch now requires a valid `@openclaw-mantis` maintainer comment before rendering or planning a Mantis request.

## Risks / Rollout

- Compatibility: new ClawSweeper structured output no longer emits Slack, generic visual, or web UI chat Mantis scenarios. Older reports remain parseable but render as non-Mantis proof guidance.
- Product scope: web UI chat Mantis support is intentionally left out until an OpenClaw Mantis PR adds a real dispatchable web UI chat proof lane.
- Security: this changes prompt/schema/rendering and bot-proof routing only; it does not add secrets, workflow permissions, or new command execution paths.

## Links

- Related OpenClaw proof-attestation discussion: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/421
- Follow-up: an `openclaw/openclaw` PR should add the web UI chat Mantis lane before ClawSweeper reintroduces `web_ui_chat_proof`.
